summary: The United States reportedly struck an Iranian oil tanker near strategic Kharg Island, marking a significant maritime escalation. Simultaneously, Israel eliminated a senior Hamas Nukhba commander in Khan Younis and conducted strikes on Hezbollah in southern Lebanon following an explosive drone attack. Hezbollah fighters remain trapped in tunnels at the Ali al-Taher heights command center.

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous US maritime strike on Iranian oil infrastructure and Israeli multi-front operations against Hamas and Hezbollah indicate a coordinated escalation strategy. Iran's entrapment of elite forces at Ali al-Taher heights and the IAEA referral push suggest Tehran faces mounting pressure on both conventional and nuclear fronts. Trump's explicit nuclear site threats and reported ballistic missile activity from Kerman raise risks of direct US-Iran confrontation. Hezbollah's degraded command structure and failed drone attack demonstrate Israeli air superiority but may provoke asymmetric retaliation.
